content.short: Block explorers, data APIs and MCP servers for 86+ networks, built on your own domain.
content.description: Routescan indexes more than 9 billion transactions across 86+ networks and turns them into products for others. Chains get a branded explorer with an API and MCP server run as a service, stablecoin and RWA issuers get public proof pages for supply and reserves, and DeFi teams get dashboards for swaps, gas and cross-chain flows. It runs explorers for networks including Plasma.
content.meta: Routescan builds branded explorers, data APIs, MCP servers and proof pages from 9B+ indexed transactions on 86+ chains.
